First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Expect 7 mph: you can talk the whole way.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

First group ride? Start here →

About the Trackstand Friday Shop Mountain Bike Ride group ride

Trackstand Friday Shop Mountain Bike Ride is a mountain bike and social group ride in Bentonville, AR. It rolls every Friday at 6:00 pm from Trackstand Cyclery and Tavern.

A casual, welcoming shop ride of about 10 miles. The group rides over to Coler Mountain Bike Preserve for Esther’s Loop at a relaxed pace, around 7 mph. It ends back at the shop and tavern for food and drinks.
